decision_rule: Continue to a new full consumed-development assessment only if all 120 rows are valid, post-type exact-set accuracy is at least 0.70, product-label exact-set accuracy is at least 0.85, outcome accuracy is at least 0.90, and context_missing recall is at least 0.50. global_stop: The client reserves the current request's conservative input estimate, full output allowance, transport attempt, and maximum price before network transport.
